dedupe_keys.name: nasa prognostics center of excellence pcoe data set repository

description: The NASA Prognostics Data Repository is a collection of data sets donated by universities, agencies and companies for developing prognostic algorithms. Most are time series that run from a nominal state to failure; coverage is international by donor, not tied to a place. The 21 data sets listed cover algae raceways, carbon fibre-reinforced polymer composites, milling, bearings (including the FEMTO bearings), batteries (several sets, including randomised usage and accelerated life testing), turbofan engine degradation simulations (two sets and the PHM08 challenge), IGBT and MOSFET ageing, capacitor electrical stress, a trebuchet, a small satellite power simulation, fatigue crack growth in aluminium lap joints, a CNC milling machine and an anemometer. Each set is a free zipped download hosted on the PHM Society's storage, with a citation to credit the donors, and the page is mirrored on the PHM Society website. Users are asked to acknowledge the repository and donors, and use the data at their own risk; no licence is stated. Caveats: sets come from laboratory experiments or simulations, not operating plants, and documentation varies by donor. For simulation it provides run-to-failure data for condition, ageing and remaining useful life models of industrial and energy equipment. Related catalogue records include the PHM Society data repository and the Tennessee Eastman dataset.
